name: Supershipped
summary: Library of editable product flows, components, animations and design systems you rebrand and ship.
description: A design library of complete end-to-end product designs: landing pages, full websites, mobile screens, microinteractions, animations, banners, illustrations and showreels. Every item is built from real components with auto-layout, variants and design tokens plus its own brand system; you preview live, copy the full file into Claude or HTML, swap brand tokens and ship. New product flow every two weeks; free tier with paid Pro and Pro+ plans.
